## Summary

Describe the change and the behavior or contract it affects.

## Validation

Describe the checks executed and any relevant limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] Code identifiers are written in English.
- [ ] New or changed PHPDoc, GoDoc and JSDoc are written in English.
- [ ] New or changed technical comments are written in English.
- [ ] Developer-facing errors/logs introduced by this change are written in English.
- [ ] User-facing strings use the localization boundary when applicable.
- [ ] New Ninfa rule IDs/metadata follow the project naming policy.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests were updated.
- [ ] Public compatibility contracts were preserved or migration was documented.
- [ ] Translation-only changes are separated from behavior changes when practical.
